```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, fig.show = "show")
```

```{r config-and-libraries, include=FALSE}
library(here)
library(dplyr)

# Load config and functions
source(here("config.R"))
source(here("3_Analysis", "functions", "stacked_bar_likert_func.r"))

# Output directory
hist_dir <- file.path(OUTPUT, "6_Histograms")
dir.create(hist_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

```{r load-data}
df <- read.csv(file.path(CLEAN_DATA, "final_dataset.csv"))
```

```{r restrict-sample}
# Keep only labgroupids with both BL and EL data, then keep the BL row
# Keep only treated groups (did checklist)
df_sample <- df %>%
  group_by(labgroupid) %>%
  filter(n() == 2) %>%
  ungroup()

df_bl <- df_sample %>% filter(survey == "BL")
df_treatment <- df_bl %>% filter(treated == 1)

# BL and EL checklist cols
checklist_cols_bl <- c(
  paste0("bronze_q_", 1:16, "_bl"),
  paste0("silver_q_", 1:18, "_bl"),
  paste0("gold_q_", 1:15, "_bl")
)
checklist_cols_el <- c(
  paste0("bronze_q_", 1:16, "_el"),
  paste0("silver_q_", 1:18, "_el"),
  paste0("gold_q_", 1:15, "_el")
)

# Keep only groups where answered at least 1 checklist q
# Then fill remaining NAs in the checklist cols with "Not applicable"
df_checklist_bl <- df_treatment %>%
  filter(rowSums(!is.na(select(., all_of(checklist_cols_bl)))) > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(checklist_cols_bl), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), "Not applicable", .))
  )

df_checklist_el <- df_treatment %>%
  filter(rowSums(!is.na(select(., all_of(checklist_cols_el)))) > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(checklist_cols_el), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), "Not applicable", .))
  )
```

```{r checklist-setup, include=FALSE}
response_order <- c( "Yes", "I don't know", "No", "Not applicable")

# Questions
bl_checklist_items <- list(
  bronze = list(n = 16, cols = paste0("bronze_q_", 1:16, "_bl")),
  silver = list(n = 18, cols = paste0("silver_q_", 1:18, "_bl")),
  gold   = list(n = 15, cols = paste0("gold_q_", 1:15, "_bl"))
)

el_checklist_items <- list(
  bronze = list(n = 16, cols = paste0("bronze_q_", 1:16, "_el")),
  silver = list(n = 18, cols = paste0("silver_q_", 1:18, "_el")),
  gold   = list(n = 15, cols = paste0("gold_q_", 1:15, "_el"))
)
```

# Bronze Checklist

```{r bl-bronze-checklist}
# Bronze checklist questions at BL
bronze_cols   <- bl_checklist_items$bronze$cols
bronze_labels <- setNames(paste0("Bronze Q", 1:16), bronze_cols)

make_stacked_bar(
  df             = df_checklist_bl,
  item_cols      = bronze_cols,
  item_labels    = bronze_labels,
  response_order = response_order,
  output_file    = "stacked_bronze_checklist_bl.pdf",
  output_dir     = hist_dir
)
```

```{r el-bronze-checklist}
# Bronze checklist questions at EL
bronze_cols   <- el_checklist_items$bronze$cols
bronze_labels <- setNames(paste0("Bronze Q", 1:16), bronze_cols)

make_stacked_bar(
  df             = df_checklist_el,
  item_cols      = bronze_cols,
  item_labels    = bronze_labels,
  response_order = response_order,
  output_file    = "stacked_bronze_checklist_el.pdf",
  output_dir     = hist_dir
)
```
